combo_box.name: anim_speed_avatar
combo_box.label: Avatar
combo_box.tool_tip: Choose you, a cast member, or a nearby avatar. The list updates when opened.

slider.name: anim_speed_slider
slider.label: Speed
slider.tool_tip: Change this whole avatar's animations in your viewer. Dance Ball keeps its own dance timing.

button.name: anim_speed_reset
button.label: Reset
button.tool_tip: Return this avatar to normal animation speed.

slider.name: anim_speed_spread
slider.label: Vary spread (%)
slider.tool_tip: How much Vary all can change each avatar from normal. 15 means 0.85x to 1.15x.

button.name: anim_speed_vary_all
button.label: Vary all
button.tool_tip: Give you, all cast members, and nearby avatars random speeds within the spread. Only changes your viewer.

button.name: anim_speed_reset_all
button.label: Reset all
button.tool_tip: Clear all avatar speed changes, including avatars that are away.
